notes.title: Update 1.1.3: Fixing the Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey guys! We put our backs into it and solved the ball freezing issue (hopefully for good this time!). We also turned on the D-Pad inversion by default on Linux (though the menu option's still there). Finally, we updated the leaderboards framework - it should be back online for everyone now.

Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Update 1.1.2 is Here!
notes.notes:
This update brings a couple of fixes for the issues you've reported.
[list]
[*]The ball won't freeze anymore if you hit pause just before winning/breaking
[*]We sorted out a memory leak that could affect performance after some time
[*]We added the option to invert the D-Pad vertical axis (useful for PS4 controllers in some setups)
[*]We tweaked a number of levels to improve visibility and/or make them easier to understand
[/list]
Thank you for playing TLBTC!

notes.title: TLBTC for Mac and Linux are Ready!
notes.notes:
We worked hard at it, and it is finally ready. The Little Ball That Could, our darling marble platformer, is now available for Mac and Linux! Now, all of you waiting for some quality roll-the-ball action set in colorful, maze-like levels filled to the brim with traps and puzzles will be able to get your fix, regardless of the OS you prefer. Leaderboards work cross-platform, and so do the cloud saves, so you can switch between operating systems and keep your progress.

Thank you all for playing TLBTC, and we hope to hear from you with any feedback you have!

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 and Some Big News!
notes.notes:
Howdy folks,

Here's another update for TLBTC fixing some minor issues we've noticed:

• Fixed the story intro scene problems that appeared on some systems
• Fixed issues with the pause menu (level name not showing, not being able to resume using the B button on the controller)
• Fixed the issue making the setting menu getting stuck while switching between tabs 

And now, as promised in the title, here's the [b]big news[/b] - in the coming days,  [b]we'll be making TLBTC available for Linux and Mac systems![/b] These versions will retain all the functionality of the Windows version (including Xbox controller support), and the leaderboards will remain unified across these platforms.

We'll get back to you as soon as these builds go live, and thanks for supporting us!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

We're rolling out a new update to TLBTC: we updated the engine and tweaked game performance, fixed several late-game levels where you could get trapped, and included some clarification related to leaderboard times.

As always, we appreciate your support, and hope to hear more feedback!

notes.title: TLBTC Free Demo is Live!
notes.notes:
After a number of updates fixing bugs and tweaking TLBTC to your taste, we finalized our work on the demo.

The demo offers a selection of five levels from the full game, each coming from one of the game’s worlds. If you're still thinking about getting TLBTC, this is your chance to experience what the game is about!

Thanks to all of you who have shown support for The Little Ball That Could!

As always, we appreciate your support, and hope to hear more feedback!

notes.title: TLBTC Gameplay Trailers Are Up!
notes.notes:
Howdy folks,

As the launch day approaches, we have published a new set of gameplay videos on our Steam page! We wanted to showcase each task type in TLBTC, so we picked three random levels and made short videos of us playing through them. We're pretty happy with them, as they encapsulate perfectly what it feels like to go for that flawless speed run, find that dastardly hidden puzzle piece, or give it your best and get all the puzzle pieces.

There's some more gameplay trailer footage to be found on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/naissusworks]YouTube channel[/url], so go there now and take a look!
